message.reasoning_content: We need to determine charges. Primary charge likely 故意伤害 (intentional injury) because they used a gun to injure. Also illegal possession of firearms? The facts: Han and others used a散弹枪 (shotgun) to shoot Zhang's leg, causing light injury. The gun is a firearm, illegal possession. The suspect Wang kept the gun and later placed it and reported. So charges: 故意伤害;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药 (illegal possession of firearms). Also maybe 妨害作证? Not indicated. The companion list includes: 妨害作证, 寻衅滋事, 强迫卖淫, 故意毁坏财物. None apply. So only primary and illegal possession. Also possibly 组织、强迫、引诱、容留、介绍卖淫? No. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>
